c74object.name: evi_audiodust
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Spikey sparse noise implementation
c74object.description:
evi_audiodust is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_audiodust is also available in MSP as: evi.audiodust~.
Audio dust is a sparse random noise source driven at a given frequency. It produces 'spikes' at random amplitude and time offsets. It can be very useful as both a control signal and an audio signal. @see: 'evi_sources.genexpr' for more where this came from.

geninlet.name: frequency
geninlet.digest: in Hz @default 10 @min -SAMPLERATE*0.5 @max SAMPLERATE*0.5. The frequency at which to internally sample the noise. Typically used at low frequencies.
